title: Aunt Lou Has A Key To YOURS 🔑
description:
My aunt has been the locksmith on our court for forty years, and she has a key to every house on it. For a month, every door has clicked at midnight, and the neighbors think she's letting herself in.

I just moved into my first place, across the court. I never gave her a key. She has one anyway, so I put a camera on my porch.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BOLTED if you checked your door just now.
